checkpoints.title: Migration and standing soft-delete protection
criteria: The timestamp and tombstone migration is present.
The structural soft-delete join guard is green.

checkpoints.title: Shared wire contract frozen
criteria: Independent encoders agree on the canonical wire corpus.
The shareable allow-list is complete and excludes device-local data.
Stored and newly written shareable text is sanitized and normalized.
The write-routing guard that W17 owns is mutation-proven.

checkpoints.title: Real client and server round trip
criteria: The real client and server agree on credentials, blobs, manifests, ETags, limits, and create-versus-connect behavior.
Connecting to a first-time missing collection reports it and performs no automatic creation.

checkpoints.title: Steady-state convergence
criteria: Three or more devices converge under interleaved edits and stale peers.
A previously used collection that is now missing pauses without creating a replacement and requests one user decision.

checkpoints.title: Attach, dedupe, deletion, and review
criteria: Fresh attach, dedupe, reconciliation, deletion, and the persistent review queue pass against the real libraries.
A confirmed replacement collection is created once and then follows the fresh-attach path.

checkpoints.title: Server retention and boundary hardening
criteria: The server rejects non-shareable data and enforces limits before allocation.
Retention, garbage collection, immediate wipe, and privacy-safe access logging pass their conformance vectors.

checkpoints.title: Low-volume beta
criteria: Sync remains off by default and makes no network call until enabled.
Backup export is offered before first connection but never starts automatically.
The app distinguishes a first-time missing collection from a previously used collection that no longer exists.
Replacement creation explains that inactivity expiry or removal may be the cause and requires confirmation; cancellation makes no network call.
The privacy-policy effective date is in force before any beta content leaves a device.
Maintainers use the beta in normal low-volume use, repair observed breakage, and make an explicit qualitative decision that it is satisfactory; no numeric user or duration threshold is required.

checkpoints.title: Release
criteria: Policy wording and effective date are rechecked.
Operational processes have been exercised against the deployed service.
The compatible server is deployed before the client release.

decisions.decision: Build and deploy the remote service as early as the shared compendium_core and wire contracts permit.
decisions.effect: After C1, land the shared W5 credential definition needed by W10, then prioritize W10 and a live test endpoint before W6 client-engine development.

decisions.decision: Offer backup export before the first connection; never start an export automatically.
decisions.effect: W13 owns an explicit offer and W8 must remain incapable of initiating export by itself.

decisions.decision: A first-time missing collection is reported and offered for creation.
decisions.effect: The connect path performs no automatic POST and remains distinct from replacement of a previously used collection.

decisions.decision: A previously used collection that no longer exists may have expired through inactivity or been removed; explain that uncertainty and require confirmation before replacement.
decisions.effect: W5 types the outcome, W6 pauses without POST, W13 owns the decision surface, and W8 fresh-attaches only after confirmed creation.

decisions.decision: The beta is a low-volume period of ordinary use, repair, and qualitative maintainer judgment rather than a statistically measured trial.
decisions.effect: C6 records observed failures and an explicit satisfactory-use decision but sets no minimum user count, duration, or numerical threshold.

decisions.decision: Track Device Sync implementation without GitHub Issues, using repository work-unit records as the source of truth and a GitHub Project as the generated view.
decisions.effect: Implementation work is represented by ADR-004 work units and their pull requests; the Project is reconciled from merged repository state.
